svg.title: Mean light use efficiency of the days 15 to 28 after the last day of a silage harvest, as a fraction of the LUE of the 14 days before the harvest, against the SPI-3 of the harvest month; one marker per episode, first cuts (n = 11) and later cuts (n = 5); a dashed line marks the dry limit SPI-3 = −1.5.
svg.desc: Two panels side by side with the same axes: first cuts (left) and later cuts (right). X axis: SPI-3 of the harvest month, from −3.25 to 1.25; a dashed vermillion vertical line at −1.5 marks the dry limit (dry = at or left of it). Y axis: mean LUE of the days +15 to +28 as a fraction of the LUE of the days −14 to −1, from 0.00 to 1.75; thin lines mark 1 and 0. Marker per site: Anttila blue circle, Särkisuo orange square, Qvidja reddish purple diamond, Viikki black pentagon; an open marker is a flagged Viikki episode (establishment year or partial harvest), not in the group statistics. 2 first cuts at or left of the dry line; no later cut has SPI-3 ≤ −1.5: the later cuts panel has no point at or left of the dry line. First cuts: qvidja-2023-06-19 SPI-3 −2.98, LUE 1.30; qvidja-2019-06-11 SPI-3 −1.86, LUE 0.52; qvidja-2018-06-12 SPI-3 −1.14, LUE 1.42; qvidja-2022-06-21 SPI-3 −0.99, LUE 1.10; anttila-2022-06-21 SPI-3 −0.33, LUE 1.03; sarkisuo-2022-06-30 SPI-3 −0.33, LUE 1.57; viikki-2024-06-14 SPI-3 −0.30, LUE 1.63 (flagged, open marker); viikki-2022-07-01 SPI-3 −0.09, LUE 1.12; qvidja-2024-06-15 SPI-3 0.59, LUE 1.25; qvidja-2021-06-14 SPI-3 0.59, LUE 0.41; viikki-2023-08-17 SPI-3 0.86, LUE 0.86 (flagged, open marker). Later cuts: qvidja-2019-08-20 SPI-3 −0.93, LUE 0.94; qvidja-2020-08-28 SPI-3 −0.39, LUE 1.28; anttila-2022-08-08 SPI-3 0.28, LUE 0.74; sarkisuo-2022-08-15 SPI-3 0.28, LUE 1.06; anttila-2023-07-19 SPI-3 0.36, LUE 0.75. Episodes without a late window (blocked or fewer than 12 LUE days): anttila-2023-06-21, qvidja-2018-09-23, qvidja-2023-08-21.
